The poll, released on Monday, Aug. 31, found that only 33% of Americans approved of Trump’s performance, a rating that has held for three straight weeks of Reuters/Ipsos tracking.

Trump's performance in the Aug. 31 poll is the lowest approval rating he has seen in Reuters/Ipsos tracking since his return to the White House in 2025. The erosion spans issues Republicans have traditionally owned, which suggests the president is entering the final stretch before the midterms facing the most intense opposition of his second term.
